description.value: The Frontier Motel sits on the Nakusp-Mica Creek Highway in the Okanagan & Thompson region of British Columbia, a rural corridor connecting the Arrow Lakes area to Mica Creek. The Facebook page for the property is titled 'The Ol' Frontier Family Restaurant and Motel,' suggesting an on-site family restaurant that could serve as a convenient stop for touring cyclists seeking an evening meal. Its location on a remote highway makes it a potentially valuable overnight option for cyclists traversing this sparsely serviced stretch.
